The Philippine Alliance of Human Rights Advocates (PAHRA), along with the families of victims of the drug war, staged a protest outside the main gate of the Senate on Monday.

The group expressed their condemnation of the changes in Senate leadership and the reported escape of Senator Ronald ‘Bato’ dela Rosa, who has been identified as co-perpetrator by the International Criminal Court (ICC) for crimes against humanity.

Read more: https://t.co/GkSN3l1NxS

data.raw_text:
With so many events cropping up lately, there was genuine concern that Fanfes 2026: 🟡Tranquil Topaz🟡 might suffer a significant drop in attendance. We were surprised that, not only was this not the case, but that the number of attendees on the second day even exceeded that of last year’s!

We’d like to thank our special guest @ryukku_k for making the event so special with her presence as well as all the amazing All-Stars that brought their brilliance to the event. 

We’d also like to thank our sponsors specially Honor of Kings whose Honor of Kings X Attack on Titan booth brought so much joy to the attendees, and filled a hole in our hearts. Thanks also goes to all the exhibitors and artists who brought their amazing products and artworks for everyone to enjoy!

We’d also like to thank Space at One Ayala by Ayala Malls for being a gracious host to us, and addressing our concerns as we truly wanted the best for all the event attendees.

Thanks also go to Synergy and our staff, who managed to work with the venue limitations to make traffic in the event go smoothly, and to TicketMax for being an outstanding ticketing partner once again.

To our hardworking staff, we’re truly grateful for all your amazing work, and for your efforts to adjust to sudden challenges while maintaining the comfort and security of our event attendees.

Our biggest thank you goes to all of you who attended! We’re overwhelmed by your support, knowing full well that this season has been packed with competing events, and yet you chose to share your time, effort and joy with us.

Thank you for shining bright with us in the second installment of the Prisma Saga! We’re looking forward to seeing you once again at Anime & Cosplay Expo 2026: 🔴Radiant Ruby🔴 on July 18-19, 2026 in Function Rooms 3-5 at the SMX Convention Center Manila, Pasay City.

Thank you everyone for your continued support for our events. We’re truly grateful, and we’re looking forward to seeing you again soon!

Sincerely,
The https://t.co/KmNdIxzx3q Family

#cosplay #cosplayph #fanfes2026 #acx2026 #prismasaga
